prerequisites.label: Skill 01 (Teach Yourself Protocol): installer must read this skill's docs before acting
prerequisites.satisfy: Run Skill 01's Teach Yourself Protocol (it installs on Wave 1, before this skill's wave) so the installing agent reads every .md in this folder before touching the system.

prerequisites.label: Skill 02 (Back Yourself Up Protocol): backup discipline for the installer's backup step
prerequisites.satisfy: Run Skill 02's Back Yourself Up Protocol (Wave 1) so the backup in INSTALL.md Step 2 uses the box's established backup discipline.

prerequisites.label: Node.js 22.13+ or 24+ to run Council with built-in SQLite
prerequisites.satisfy: Use the host's managed Node.js 22.13+ or 24+ runtime for Council. The installer runs a real in-memory node:sqlite write/read preflight before installing. Standalone packaging/doctor scripts may run on an older Node, but this does not make the runtime usable.

check.note: The pinned Command Center (see cc-compat.json) carries no council contract. The portable skill installs and registers regardless; managed visual mode reports its precise not-ready state until a paired Command Center release lands. Standalone mode is unaffected. Never report visual mode as ready.

prerequisites.label: Managed (visual) mode needs a Command Center release carrying the council contract; none exists yet
prerequisites.satisfy: No action available at install time. Install the skill; managed mode becomes available when a compatible Command Center release is installed through its own update path.
